# Find the maximum points value in the Points column
max_points = df['Points'].max()
# Filter rows where Points equals the maximum points value
riders_with_max_points = df[df['Points'] == max_points]['Rider'].tolist()
# Return a single entity (the rider with the most points)
answer = riders_with_max_points[0] if riders_with_max_points else None
